android.desc:
Plex is the free social and discovery app for movie and TV lovers.
 
Discover your next watch with Plex. Find shows and movies to watch, see what's trending, get ratings and movie reviews from friends you trust, and stream free on-demand movies, shows, and live TV.
 
Connect all your streaming services (including Netflix, Max, Paramount+, Prime Video, and more) to Plex to browse them all from one place. If you can stream it, we can find it.
 
Watch over 50,000 free movies and shows across every genre from A24, Paramount, AMC, Magnolia, Relativity, Lionsgate, and more. Your next binge is waiting.
 
Stream 600+ free live TV channels featuring live sports, news, kids’ shows, and more. Save your favorite channels for later or start watching now.
 
Find movies and shows from anywhere, add them to your Plex watchlist, and  keep everything you want to watch in one place. Customize your preferences and build a home screen around what you love to watch.
 
Share TV and movie reviews, create lists, and start discussions about the movies and shows you love. Find movies and shows to watch  through ratings, movie reviews, and real recommendations from real people—not an algorithm.
 
Enjoy your personal media, your way, with a Plex Media Server. Store, organize, and stream your movies, shows, music, and photos from one library. Your server automatically scans your files, making them easy to browse and enjoy from any device.
 
With Plex, you can:
●      Find new movies and shows and discover your next binge
●      Watch 50,000+ free movies and shows
●      Stream 600+ free live TV channels
●      Browse all your streaming services in one place
●      Watchlist any movie or TV show from anywhere 	
●      Share TV and movie reviews, create lists, and join discussions
●      Stream your personal media with Plex Media Server
 
Download the free Plex app to get started. Visit https://www.plex.tv/free for more information.
 
Note: Streaming personal media requires Plex Media Server version 1.41.2 or higher (available for free at https://plex.tv/downloads) installed and running to stream to other devices. DRM-protected content, ISO disc images, and video_ts folders are not supported. Some features of this app are supported by interest-based advertising. To learn more about this and your choices regarding it, visit the Plex Privacy Policy.

quotes.text:
Here are some that I have on my Atrix that aren't already listed (as far as I can tell) -

    Plex for Android - https://market.android.com/details?id=com.plexapp.android&feature=search_result

    DoubleTwist w/AirSync and AirPlay - https://market.android.com/search?q=doubletwist&so=1&c=apps

    Go Launcher EX w/various themes and widgets - https://market.android.com/details?id=com.gau.go.launcherex&feature=search_result

    WiFi Explorer - https://market.android.com/details?id=com.dooblou.WiFiFileExplorerfeature=search_result

    Google+ - Great app, uploads my photos instantly and automatically - worth for that itself.

Go Launcher is my default launcher - smooth, doesn't get in the way too much and is fairly stable. Has a ton of themes, widgets and addons.

Plex is on both my Tablet and Phone - put my old HP Mini to work connected to my router and portable 1TB drive which has all my media that can be viewed with Plex remotely. Great looking app with great features!

WiFi Explorer is useful for transferring files to and from the phone over your WiFi network using a browser - seems to work great.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What Android apps do you use?
